description: The requirements are pasted, naming a path that is not on disk, and the user does not ask for chat only. The plan is in chat, and its last line says it was not saved.

must_match.why: the reply is the plan: it starts at the Approach heading, with no preamble

must_match.pattern: ^Not saved: the requirements were pasted, not read from a file\. Name a folder to save plan\.md in\.\s*\Z
must_match.why: a plan that is not saved says so, in the last line

must_not_match.why: nothing is saved from pasted requirements
no Revision History, closing note, or rule in a chat reply
